question: Can an installation token be minted with a subset of the App's permissions and repos?
pass: Yes (section 6), as the working rulings on #187 read it. At the Maintainer's terminal, by tools/trial_p4_narrow.sh: an installation token for the trial-author App, minted with permissions a subset of the installation's (contents read alone) and repositories naming one repo, is answered 201 with exactly that subset as permissions and repository_selection selected; a read the subset permits (the named repo's README through the contents API) is answered 200; a write the subset does not permit (a PUT to the contents API) is answered 403; and a read of a repository the token does not name is refused, with 404 or 403, never 200. The redaction deletes the token and the fixture keeps the requests and the statuses.

body.words: A token can be minted with a subset of the App's permissions and repositories (201, contents read with metadata read, which GitHub adds, and the canary alone). The permissions subset holds: a read it permits is answered 200 and a write it does not is refused 403. The repository subset does not narrow a read: the token read the root of combsmith/software-factory, a repository it does not name and the App is not installed on, and was answered 200, because every repository of the org is public and any token reads public content. A write beyond the named repository could not be tried, since the App's installation reaches the canary alone. So the condition's last clause fails, and section 5.1's 'a token cannot reach a repo its Run is not about' holds for writes and private repos only.
